title: CobbleCustom
description: Cobblemon Official with a few add-ons for QoL and better interactions.
body:
_A custom cobblemon pack, built by one person for his small group of friends and anyone else interested!_

**CobbleCustom** is a modpack combining Cobblemon Offical with many of the add-ons available on the website to add interactions such as Mega Evolution, Dynamaxxing, Z-Moves and more whilst also adding Pokemon not in the original mod! QoL mods have also been added for better Elytra flight, easier crafting, etc. Alongside these mods are a few to ensure everything runs smoother for those with lackluster set-ups so everyone can play!

**CobbleCustom** _is not directly connected to any outside material, and is solely for usage on a server owned by the creator and a few of his close friends. Though is made public for anyone wishing to also experience the fun that could be had._
